source.original_feedback_text: Overall good work, however, Scenario 1 only explores the prerequisite path and omits the approval pathway. Scenario 3 fails to compile because provable is redeclared with both def and opaque, which Lean flags as a name conflict; this prevents that proof from being verified. The same issue carries over into Part 2, where all four theorems are logically sound and well explained but are impacted by the compile error due to the redeclaration.
source.notes: Marks and textual feedback were manually transcribed from the human marking record. Requirement mappings were assigned conservatively where the marker feedback clearly supports them. The compilation issue is recorded separately from logical correctness because the marker explicitly states that the Part 2 theorems are logically sound but affected by a shared declaration error.
